title: Ledger says 'spy' chip inside CryptoBilis Ledger devices transmitted wallet keys over mobile network
reason: Confirmed spy chip transmitting wallet keys is a major security breach with a named company, corroborated by retailer pullout coverage elsewhere.

sources.summary: Ledger said it will review its reseller policies and announced and that investigations to determine who tampered with the devices will continue.

title: South Korea blocks 27 crypto exchanges, including Bitmart and Kucoin
reason: Regulatory enforcement action against 27 named exchanges confirmed by two sources is clearly publishable.

sources.summary: The country’s regulators are stepping up their earlier restrictions on mobile apps to websites, targeting unregistered exchanges before investors report losses.
Authorities said the restrictions are aimed at unregistered exchanges and have acknowledged that customers could have difficulty withdrawing assets.
